subject: Staggered onboarding plan for 3 runtime/infra hires (Q4 request)
messages:
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Staggered onboarding plan for 3 runtime/infra hires (Q4 request)

Hi Laura and Jonas,

I'm requesting approval to open and commit to 3 engineering hires on the runtime/platform infra team for the FY24 Q4 hiring window. The ask is intentionally staggered to match project milestones and budget phasing: 

- 1x Senior Runtime Engineer (IC5) — target start: early Jan 2027
- 1x Platform Engineer (IC4) — target start: late Dec 2026
- 1x Runtime SRE (IC4) — target start: March 2027 (deferred if needed)

Rationale: we have two feature rollouts (continuous KV cache + kernel-selection rollout) that need a senior lead and a platform engineer for integration, while the SRE hire can follow once initial pieces are live. Staggering reduces immediate headcount burn while preserving capacity for the Dec/Jan ramp.

Attachments: hc_request_q4.xlsx (headcount spreadsheet with monthly burn and capex offset), job_desc_runtime_infra.md (draft JD).

Requests:
- Approval to open the three reqs and commit to the phased start dates above (budget bucket: Platform - Infra).
- Confirm whether we can apply existing Dedicated credits or Q4 marketplace credits to offset the platform infra cost in Jan.
- If approved, Hannah will push reqs to Greenhouse and coordinate offers.

Happy to jump on a quick call; otherwise please reply with approvals/comments by EOD Friday so recruiting can start prepping.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: hc_request_q4.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: job_desc_runtime_infra.md (text)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Staggered onboarding plan for 3 runtime/infra hires (Q4 request)

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 9:04 AM soojin_lee@redwood.ai wrote:
> I'm requesting approval to open and commit to 3 engineering hires ...

Thanks for pulling this together, Soojin. A few notes from the tech side: 

- For the Senior Runtime role I strongly recommend we scope it as IC5 with a preference for candidates who can also own kernel-selection experiments (hard requirement). If we can't find IC5, we should consider stretching comp to land a strong IC4+ with similar experience.
- Can we accelerate the Platform Engineer to start in Dec (vs late Dec) if recruiting identifies candidates? Dec onboarding would help with the Jan rollout.
- The SRE role can be moved to a hiring freeze if Q1 headcount looks tight, but prefer to keep the req open.

Also: are the Dedicated credits documented in the HC spreadsheet? If not, please add a row showing expected offset (we can try to swap some capacity budget). Dev, can you confirm whether reserved credits are earmarked or flexible?

I can be available for a 20-min sync if helpful.

— Jonas
Lead, Platform Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Bcc: amy.carroll@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-11-18T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Staggered onboarding plan for 3 runtime/infra hires (Q4 request)

Appreciate the concise plan. A few items I need before I can sign off: 

- Line-item monthly cost per hire (base salary + benefits + equity runrate) and total incremental OPEX impact for Q4 and Q1. Please put this in the HC spreadsheet under a new "total cost" column.
- Conservative comp bands for each role (low/target/high) so finance can model worst-case.
- If possible, compress the timeline so at least two hires can be onboarded before end of Jan; the kernel-selection work is blocking a delivery target.

Cc'ing Amy (finance) to flag the ask; Amy, can you confirm whether the marketplace credits/committed discounts can be applied to offset the platform infra spend in Jan? If not, we need to rework the timing.

If you can get the updated spreadsheet to me by EOD Thursday I can approve conditioned on the numbers.

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks — added the cost rows and conservative bands to hc_request_q4.xlsx and attached the market comp memo. Summary of recommended ranges (total comp annual):

- Senior Runtime Engineer (IC5) — low: $220k / target: $260k / high: $300k
- Platform Engineer (IC4) — low: $150k / target: $180k / high: $210k
- Runtime SRE (IC4) — low: $140k / target: $170k / high: $200k

Notes: ranges reflect Bay Area market data and include estimated benefits run-rate. Attachment comp_band_market_lookup.pdf includes comparative offers and 90th/50th percentiles. I've also added the recommended interview loop for each role in job_desc_runtime_infra.md.

Vendor: Greenhire (greenhire@greenhire.io) has two strong pipeline candidates for the Platform Engineer if we want to accelerate. I can engage them once reqs are opened.

Attachments: comp_band_market_lookup.pdf, hc_request_q4.xlsx (updated).

— Hannah Schmitt
Senior Recruiter, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Staggered onboarding plan for 3 runtime/infra hires (Q4 request)

Thanks everyone — conditional approval granted. Decision and next steps: 

- Approve opening two reqs now: Senior Runtime Engineer (IC5) and Platform Engineer (IC4). Recruiter can start outreach and push Greenhouse reqs.
- Approve the Runtime SRE req to be opened as a rolling req with start date no earlier than 2027-03-01; we will revisit in the Jan planning review.
- Finance: conditional on marketplace credits confirmation. If Amy confirms credits can be applied, we will proceed with compressed timeline (two hires into Dec/Jan). If not, we hold Platform Engineer to earliest late Dec start.

Action items:
- Hannah: open requisitions in Greenhouse, attach final JDs, and provide 2 offer bands (conservative + competitive) for each role by EOD Monday.
- Soojin/Jonas: prepare a 10-minute tech kickoff doc for interviews (focus on kernel selection/KV cache work) and a ramp plan for the first 90 days.
- Dev: confirm whether Dedicated credits are fungible and update the HC spreadsheet once confirmed.

Once Hannah provides the offer bands and Dev confirms credits, I will issue final approval for offers to be extended.

Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

[Inline note: Amy (Finance) — please reply on the thread whether credits can be used; if yes, indicate approximate $ offset figure and any accounting caveats.]
